sections.title: Driver board management menu
sections.content:
To view and manage the boards shown in the Mobile App, do the following:
* On the main menu bar, select Fleet > Driver boards.

![](/uploads/87bd780a8ef0be829ee0b32e.png)

* The system shows the list of driver boards.

![](/uploads/8bbc2ef670c59e0067182042.png)

sections.title: Creating a driver board
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

Go to the **Driver boards** menu and click the create button.

### Step 2

Enter the information:

- Title: enter the name of the notice (this name is not shown in the mobile app).

- Description: enter the content of the board (this part is shown in the mobile app).

![](/uploads/b568f5777e897af128e52257.png)

- You can use some basic formatting for the notice content:

![](/uploads/1c3373c625b23e4610a95b3d.png)

![](/uploads/58ee15c42c4a3843bd657930.png)

### Step 3

Click the save button to finish creating the board.

Note: a newly created board is only in the **DRAFT** state. You have to confirm it before it appears in the mobile app for drivers.

sections.title: Confirming a driver board
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

On a board in the **DRAFT** state, click **CONFIRM**:

![](/uploads/59141f9f2e5260b211149035.png)

The board moves to the CONFIRMED state. Only then does it appear in the mobile app for drivers.

![](/uploads/9ca713ed97e118616dcb669b.png)

![](/uploads/dff23ee90ace2bef39186321.jpg)

sections.title: Sorting driver boards
sections.content:
Back on the board list, you can drag and drop the boards to change their order.

Move the mouse pointer to the drag handle of a board. Hold the handle down, drag the board to the position you want, then release the mouse to reorder it.

This order is the order in which the boards appear in the Mobile App.

![](/uploads/f2a559ab5f31696cb396c2d4.png)
